review.backTranslation: What is a variant of the same element with a different number of neutrons called?

riddles.text: 一个生物体全部遗传物质的总和叫什么？

review.backTranslation: What is the sum total of all genetic material in an organism called?

riddles.text: 构成大部分洋壳的深色火山岩是什么？

review.backTranslation: What is the dark volcanic rock that makes up most of the oceanic crust?

riddles.text: 位于原子核内并带正电的粒子是什么？

review.backTranslation: What is the particle located in the atomic nucleus and carrying a positive charge?

riddles.text: 眼球后部内壁上负责感光的一层组织叫什么？

review.backTranslation: What is the light-sensitive layer of tissue on the inner wall at the back of the eyeball called?

riddles.text: 种子植物中携带雄性生殖细胞的粉末状物质是什么？

review.backTranslation: What is the powdery substance in seed plants that carries male reproductive cells?

riddles.text: 水通过半透膜移向溶质浓度较高一侧的过程叫什么？

review.backTranslation: What is the process in which water moves through a semipermeable membrane toward the side with higher solute concentration called?

riddles.text: 哪种原子序数为二的元素常用于填充派对气球？

review.backTranslation: Which element with atomic number two is often used to fill party balloons?

riddles.text: 地球最外部坚硬且分裂成移动板块的一层叫什么？

review.backTranslation: What is the hard outermost layer of Earth, split into moving plates, called?

riddles.text: 为解决强CP问题而提出的假想粒子叫什么？

review.backTranslation: What hypothetical particle was proposed to solve the strong CP problem?

riddles.text: 光子、胶子和希格斯粒子属于哪一类粒子？

review.backTranslation: Which class of particles do photons, gluons, and the Higgs particle belong to?

riddles.text: 电化学电池中发生氧化反应的是哪个电极？

review.backTranslation: In an electrochemical cell, at which electrode does the oxidation reaction occur?

riddles.text: 哪种基本粒子每三个结合起来可形成质子或中子？

review.backTranslation: Which fundamental particle can combine in groups of three to form protons or neutrons?

riddles.text: 包裹许多神经纤维并形成绝缘层的物质是什么？

review.backTranslation: What substance wraps many nerve fibers and forms an insulating layer?

riddles.text: 界以下、纲以上的分类等级叫什么？

review.backTranslation: What is the taxonomic rank below kingdom and above class called?

riddles.text: 哪种快速自转的中子星会规律地发出辐射束？

review.backTranslation: Which rapidly rotating neutron star regularly emits beams of radiation?

riddles.text: 失去电子和得到电子同时发生的一类反应，简称什么？

review.backTranslation: What is the abbreviated name for the class of reactions in which losing electrons and gaining electrons occur simultaneously?

riddles.text: 位于染色体同一座位上的某个基因的不同形式叫什么？

review.backTranslation: What is a different form of a gene located at the same locus on a chromosome called?

riddles.text: 日全食时可见的太阳高温外层大气叫什么？

review.backTranslation: What is the Sun’s hot outer atmosphere, visible during a total solar eclipse, called?

riddles.text: 阳光下我会跟着你，天黑后却不见了。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: In sunlight I follow you, but after it gets dark I disappear. What am I?

riddles.text: 每次呼喊我都会回应，却从不先开口。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: Every time someone calls out, I respond, but I never speak first. What am I?

riddles.text: 我有一张脸和两只手，却没有胳膊和腿。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I have a face and two hands, but no arms or legs. What am I?

riddles.text: 我照亮周围时，身体会越来越短。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: When I light up my surroundings, my body gets shorter and shorter. What am I?

riddles.text: 我擦得越干，自己反而越湿。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: The more I dry by wiping, the wetter I become. What am I?

riddles.text: 我浑身是洞，却依然能吸住水。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I am covered in holes, yet I can still hold onto water. What am I?

riddles.text: 我只有一只眼，却什么也看不见，身后还拖着线。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I have only one eye, but cannot see anything, and I drag thread behind me. What am I?

riddles.text: 一旦告诉别人，我可能就无法独自保守了。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: Once I tell others, I may no longer be able to keep it by myself. What am I?

riddles.text: 我永远在你前方，却始终看不见。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I am always ahead of you, yet can never be seen. What am I?

riddles.text: 一说出我的名字，我就消失了。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: As soon as my name is spoken, I disappear. What am I?

riddles.text: 我沉入水中让船停稳，启航前又会被拉起。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I sink into the water to keep a boat steady, and before it sets sail I am pulled up again. What am I?

riddles.text: 我有许多牙齿，能把两边合在一起，却从不咬人。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I have many teeth and can join two sides together, but I never bite people. What am I?

riddles.text: 我会映出你的模样，却把左右对调。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I reflect your appearance, but swap left and right. What am I?

riddles.text: 我有脖子却没有头，头顶还常戴着帽子。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I have a neck but no head, and often wear a cap on top. What am I?

riddles.text: 我横跨空隙，自己不动却能让行人通过。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I span a gap; I do not move, but I let pedestrians pass. What am I?

riddles.text: 我有一级级横档，自己不会跑，却能帮你爬高。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I have step-like rungs; I cannot run, but I can help you climb high. What am I?

riddles.text: 我是一条有入口和出口，却通常没有窗户的通道。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I am a passage with an entrance and an exit, but usually no windows. What am I?

riddles.text: 我是衣服上会随你移动的小布洞。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I am a small cloth hole on clothes that moves along with you. What am I?

riddles.text: 我虽守着一个角落，却能走遍世界。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: Though I stay in one corner, I can travel all over the world. What am I?

riddles.text: 我让你看到外面，同时把风雨挡在屋外。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I let you see outside, while keeping wind and rain outside the house. What am I?

riddles.text: 我有牙齿却不能咀嚼，还能帮你整理头发。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I have teeth but cannot chew, and can help you arrange your hair. What am I?

riddles.text: 我有五根手指，却没有骨头和皮肤。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I have five fingers, but no bones or skin. What am I?

riddles.text: 我有嘴也有床，却从不吃饭或睡觉。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I have a mouth and also a bed, but I never eat or sleep. What am I?

riddles.text: 剥掉我一层层外衣，可能会让你流泪。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: Peel off my layers of outer clothing, and I may make you shed tears. What am I?

riddles.text: 我没有翅膀也能飘在空中，有时还会带来雨水。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I can float in the sky without wings, and sometimes bring rainwater. What am I?

riddles.text: 我生有脊梁，夹着许多叶，却并非草木。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I have a spine and hold many leaves, but I am not grass or wood/a plant. What am I?

riddles.text: 我标出各地和道路，里面却没有真正的楼房或汽车。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I mark places and roads, but inside there are no real buildings or cars. What am I?

riddles.text: 我能打开锁，却不是门。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I can open locks, but I am not a door. What am I?

riddles.text: 给我吃的，我就活；给我喝的，我就死。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: Give me food and I live; give me something to drink and I die. What am I?

riddles.text: 我能充满整个房间，却不占一点地方。我是什么？

review.backTranslation: I can fill the whole room, but do not take up any space. What am I?
